answer: One concrete mechanism: lock a compute bond for six epochs and slash it the moment two answers fingerprint-match. Clustering on shared timing signatures exposes the operator. Because it works by requiring post-paid stake that is forfeited on detection, the bond burns and standing resets to zero. The ember of work and the fable of evidence must both recur for the same identity, and a pigment to an external peer is the only path that releases the bond.
